zh: 把「动画效果」设为减弱之后，工作强度滑杆顶档的点阵仍按运行时写下的动画时长闪一次；现在这一档不写动画的周期与相位，点阵静止。
en: With Animation set to Reduced, the reasoning-effort slider's top-rung matrix still flashed once per block on the duration written at run time; that duration and phase are not written in this setting now, and the matrix stands still.
